## Interpretation rules

### Prices
MotoIndex prices are dated observations or manufacturer/dealer/comparison-site references. They can differ by dealer, location, variant, promotion, financing and date. Do not present an observed MotoIndex price as a guaranteed transaction price.

### Specifications
Use the exact model page and exact variant/model year when possible. Where sources conflict, preserve the distinction rather than averaging incompatible records.

### Recommendations
MotoIndex recommendation pages use measurable factors such as price, weight, seat height, engine, transmission, braking equipment, fuel economy, traffic context and rider-fit considerations. A ranking is a decision aid, not an objective universal quality score.

### Fitment
Tire dimensions, accessory capacity and generic mounting plates do not independently prove compatibility. Exact motorcycle, generation/year, bracket/rack, interface, load rating and clearance should be checked.

### Calculators
Loan, insurance, registration and ownership-cost tools are planning estimates. They are not lender quotes, insurance quotes, dealer quotations or government fee determinations.

### Regulatory information
For licensing, registration, ownership transfer, insurance and other legal/regulatory questions, use MotoIndex for explanatory context and verify the current requirements with the relevant Philippine authority.

### Freshness
Price, availability, dealer offers, specifications, maintenance schedules and regulations can change. Preserve the source date shown by MotoIndex when citing time-sensitive information.

## Canonical URL policy

Prefer canonical URLs listed in this file. Do not treat URL parameters or temporary faceted/filter states as separate canonical resources unless MotoIndex explicitly establishes them as canonical.

Examples that should not normally be added as separate resources:
- /motorcycles?budget=...
- /motorcycles?make=...
- /motorcycles?type=...
- Other temporary filter/query URLs

## Maintenance policy for this file

Update this file when MotoIndex:
- publishes a new canonical motorcycle model;
- adds or removes a brand hub;
- publishes a new canonical buying guide;
- adds or changes a calculator;
- changes a canonical URL;
- publishes a new ownership, maintenance, gear or fitment resource.

The model catalog is dynamic. The list above is a point-in-time canonical index and should be regenerated when the site structure changes.

Last reviewed: September 6, 2026.
